newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June T-bond futures finish week sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June T-bond futures finish week sharply lower.

text.p: April 11 - U.S. June T-bond futures ended the week sharply lower and below former support in the upper 106-00 handle. Support now at September 1996 levels, including 105-20/32. Traders agree the tone is weak heading into next week and March CPI on Tuesday. One futures analyst said strong CPI would shove June T-bonds another point lower and pop the cash long bond yield to 7.25 pct.
